construction: UFF relaxation of sugar, phosphate, terminal caps, and glycosidic attachments while every product-base atom is fixed to the SDF-serialized audited core
requirements: the input rigid graft, chemical definition, product minimum, stable atom map, and all outputs are hash-pinned
the exact 63-atom, charge -1 product graph is retained
SDF serialization moves no product-core atom more than 0.001 angstrom from the audited XYZ and the serialized core is then fixed coordinate-for-coordinate
no reflection, endpoint exchange, or stereochemical inversion is permitted
UFF reports parameters for every atom and converges; UFF is used only to repair a QM starting geometry and is not a parameter or energy authority
both glycosidic bonds and both product crosslinks lie within catastrophic-input bounds
all covalent bonds and nonbonded heavy-atom contacts pass broad covalent-radius overlap screens
known_limitations: UFF emits a phosphate charge-state warning in RDKit even though every atom receives a UFF type
the tiny serialization perturbation selects a different local UFF basin and is not physical sampling
the 1N4E d(TpT) sugar/phosphate coordinates are a deterministic boundary seed, not structural or parameter authority for an anti photoproduct
a completed optimization still requires a frequency calculation and all force-field validation gates
